section: LeafReader validation boundary and remaining-gates implementation plan
Implementation sequence

preconditions: reviewed LOCK-002 generator-binding decision before pinned-file slices
baseline_steps: record revision, dirty state, Swift version, package graph, source hashes, CLI surface, and evidence hashes
build existing evaluator and POS executables in isolation
capture authorized self-tests, small development fixtures, raw timing/provenance, exits, and validator results
freeze normalization rules before post-extraction output
verify current sealed generator hashes and record binding decision before pinned edits

ordered_commits.name: target scaffold and boundary
steps: add internal library and test targets only
add boundary check and negative fixtures first
add non-authoritative CURRENT.md
prove no-content scaffold parity
prove isolated Validation build/link path without changing pinned runner before effective binding decision

ordered_commits.name: schemas and Core observation seam
steps: move two study schema files and their tests without Codable drift
retain only immutable production-fact snapshot and Core-only construction errors
move fixed-bank, A/B1/B2 evaluation, and bank-specific errors to Validation
remove selectionOverride from Core and keep selected-set counterfactuals in Validation
in same commit update causal/longitudinal script imports and pinned evaluator wrapper to build/link Validation alongside Core
compile moved evaluator against read-only package-scoped snapshot facts
prove snapshot and runner parity plus integrated evaluator self-test at commit boundary

ordered_commits.name: assessment, causal, and longitudinal runners
steps: move shared synthetic/replay/forensic/manifest/report/provenance/metric mechanics
retain thin compatible command/file adapters and Commit 2 wrapper/import/link integration
prove clean build without cached Core or Validation modules
compare locked old/new outputs before deleting duplicates

ordered_commits.name: POS and cross-format helpers
steps: move reusable Swift validation execution helpers
keep lexical identity, occurrence accounting, inventory, parsing, and objectives in Core
retain Python analysis role
use fresh POS development material for new scoring/tuning; allow read-only historical validation

ordered_commits.name: enforcement, documentation, and stop
steps: wire boundary and validation checks into check.sh
verify paths, historical baseline Git blobs, current approved generator binding, and report parity
document only the implemented boundary
publish checkpoint and stop without model redesign
